events.message: First character saved through UI; ready and online
Coordinated exploration begins after shared go signal
Walked to public gate using keyboard and selected Return to my home
Renamed owned planet to Test explorer 3 using menu and enabled Smooth quality
Placed one Bench via catalogue, canvas click and Place object UI
Reload kept saved appearance, Test explorer 3 name, Smooth choice and 42/64 objects
Atlas lists Test explorer 1 and Test explorer 2 as read-only neighbours with 42 saved objects each
Bounded UI test complete; browser closed only, all data retained

limits: Agent-driven UI with read-only DOM diagnostics; not a human usability study.
No overnight persistence, physical-phone, WAN timing, adversarial permissions or physical cross-visit in user3 run.
crossObservation: Atlas visibly listed Test explorer 1 and Test explorer 2 as read-only neighbours, each with 42 saved objects; no physical cross-visit attempted.
isolation: Separate persistent Chrome process/profile from users 1 and 2; no shared cookie jar or desktop focus.
quality: Started on Auto/Standard; changed through menu to Smooth before placing bench; preference retained after reload.
harnessIssues: Wrong teleport-action selector corrected to visible teleport-go.
Smooth initially treated as button; corrected to quality-select dropdown.
Rename closes Pause; reopened menu before Build.
Immediate post-refresh screenshot caught camera transition; settled screenshot supersedes it.
Initial savedCount included the select placeholder; corrected to visible menu count 42/64 and saved Bench 42.
observations: Initial idle UI briefly showed connection interrupted/offline retrying; recovered without reload before movement. Cause unknown.
Visible gate route plus short A/W walking reached public gate; no deadlock observed on this route.
Two other visible visitors in DOM diagnostic at common start; pixels showed another traveller before leaving harbour.
One late read-only universe request failed with net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED while report was being finalised; no save was in progress.
dataRetention: All production identity, named planet and new bench remain saved. Private persistent browser profile retained.
